assistant.summary: Minseok Song의 기술 전략 컨설팅 역량, 도메인 기반 사업화 전략, 연구 및 공인 자격을 정리한 프로필 화면입니다.
assistant.shortAnswer: About 화면은 Minseok Song의 기술 전략 컨설팅 전문성, 딥테크 타당성 분석, 특허 및 비즈니스 대회 수상 이력을 빠르게 파악하는 곳입니다.
assistant.detailAnswer: 도메인 지식을 바탕으로 엔지니어링 타당성을 비즈니스 전략과 특허 로드맵으로 치환하는 역량, KAIST NNFC 및 KRISS 연구 인턴십, KSNT(제1저자 포스터) 및 AAiCON(제2저자) 학술 발표, 4건의 비즈니스 전략 및 2건의 AI 경진대회/학술 수상(총 6회) 이력을 일목요연하게 보여줍니다.

hero.title: Minseok Song
hero.subtitle: Technology Strategy & Business Consulting | Deep Tech Feasibility & IP Architecture

blocks.title: Operating Thesis
blocks.body: My strength is Proactive Execution—transforming complex technical challenges into valuable Deep Tech strategies.

blocks.title: Lead
blocks.body: I am a Technology Strategist specializing in business feasibility, IP portfolio structuring, and commercial translation. Grounded in semiconductor fabrication and metrology domain depth, I evaluate technical constraints and convert complex engineering into executable market strategies.

blocks.title: Body 1
blocks.body: My work bridges engineering feasibility with commercial strategy. From self-filing multi-agent AI patents (10-2026-0009508) to architecting recipe automation workflows informed by cleanroom operations, I focus on translating domain depth into high-margin business models and scalable product value.

blocks.title: Body 2
blocks.body: Across national business and case competitions, I led unit-cost modeling, public patent commercialization, and market-entry roadmaps—winning 4 business venture awards and 2 applied AI awards by identifying unmet industry needs and structuring viable solutions.
